It first aired in Japan on April 3, 2014 and in the United States on May 31, 2014. {{spoilers}} ==Other posters and logos== File:XYS01 poster.png|Poster File:XYS01 logo JP.png|Logo ==Blurb== Alain and his Charizard are on a mission to seek out and challenge Mega-Evolved Pokémon! They battle and defeat Astrid and her Mega Absol, unaware that they’re being watched. The observer is a young Trainer named Mairin, who’s just started her journey with her Chespin—and who has a lot of questions about Mega Evolution! Alain tells her he doesn’t have all the answers, but she’s still asking questions when he gets a call and has to leave. She follows him to a cave, where he finds a Mega Stone. When he emerges, he’s challenged by Dragon Tamer Remo and his Mega Garchomp—with the Mega Stone on the line! Alain wins again, and afterward, Mairin tells him that she wants to learn to use Mega Evolution, too. But first, she’ll have to catch some more Pokémon! Alain helps Mairin catch a Flabébé, and then he disappears when she takes it to a Pokémon Center. Nurse Joy tells Mairin that he went to a nearby restaurant to challenge the owner, Siebold of the Elite Four, and his Mega Blastoise. Mairin catches up just in time to watch the battle! The type disadvantage is too much for Charizard to overcome even after it Mega Evolves, and Alain is defeated—but Siebold is impressed with his strength. After the battle, Alain continues his journey, and Mairin is determined to go along with him and find a Mega Stone of her own! ==Plot== [[Alain]], a determined {{pkmn|Trainer}}, aims to defeat all [[Mega Evolution|Mega-Evolved]] {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} using his [[Alain's Charizard|Mega Charizard X]]. In his latest {{pkmn|battle}}, he challenges [[Astrid]] to Mega Evolve her {{p|Absol}}. Alain starts things off with a {{m|Flamethrower}}, though Absol counters with a {{m|Psycho Cut}} before rushing forward using {{m|Megahorn}}. Charizard, however, grabs its horn to block the attack. At this, Alain suggests they both unleash their full power and Mega Evolve their Pokémon. Astrid complies, tapping her [[Key Stone]] earring to activate Absol's [[Absolite]], and transforming it into Mega Absol, giving it a fearsome winged appearance. Alain follows on with his Charizard Mega Evolving into a Mega Charizard X. Mega Charizard X flies into action with {{m|Steel Wing}}, which collides with Mega Absol's Megahorn counterattack. The shockwaves sent through the air get the attention of the curious beginner, [[Mairin]], who stops to watch the match unfold. Mega Absol is pushed back by an intense {{m|Dragon Claw}} and Flamethrower. Mega Charizard X prevails by using {{m|Blast Burn}} to counter Absol's {{m|Dark Pulse}}. With the match over, both Mega Absol and Mega Charizard X revert back to their typical forms. Astrid is impressed by Alain’s remarkable strength, and he replies that he hopes to face other powerful Trainers like her in the future. While Alain and Charizard take a break by a river, Alain senses that he is being watched and orders the person to show themselves. Mairin and her {{p|Chespin}} [[nickname]]d [[Chespie]] nervously emerge from hiding, before admitting they watched the battle that just unfolded. Alain is confused and asks if she wants a battle. Mairin replies with absolutely not, as she is just a beginning Trainer. But then she brings up gossip from [[Lumiose City]] that a rampaging {{TP|Professor Sycamore|Garchomp}} [[XY002|ran loose]] and that {{Ash|a Trainer}} freed her from enemy control, and afterwards saved {{AP|a Pokémon|Pikachu}} falling from [[Prism Tower]]. Alain finally introduces himself, admitting that he and Charizard want to master Mega Evolution. Mairin is intrigued by the temporary phenomenon known as Mega Evolution, to which Alain admits is still a big mystery. He recalls his time as one of {{an|Professor Sycamore}}'s aides, where he first learned of Mega Evolution. Determined to learn more, Alain set off on a journey to search for a Mega Stone, and Professor Sycamore allowed him to take a {{p|Charmander}} along. Suddenly, he receives a call where to go next, with Mairin tagging along, her curiosity piqued. Mairin finds Alain in some old ruins. Inside, Alain finds a [[Mega Stone]], but is unsure as to which Pokémon it corresponds to. As he walks out, a man named [[Remo]] challenges him to battle, claiming that he needs the Mega Stone to bring it to his boss. Alain accepts, and Remo introduces to Charizard a Garchomp nicknamed Garchoo. Keen for a challenge, both opponents immediately Mega Evolve their Pokémon. Garchoo makes the first [[move]], pushing Mega Charizard X back with a {{m|Dragon Rush}}. Mega Charizard X takes to the air before firing at its opponent. Remo orders Garchoo to go into the air, though Mega Charizard X escapes its {{m|Dual Chop}} attack. Alain calls for a Dragon Claw, which exchanges blows with Garchoo's Dual Chop. An explosive clash sends both sides into the battlefield below, with Charizard winning and Garchoo collapsing from his wounds. Alain leaves the ruins with his new Mega Stone in hand. He notices Mairin still following him, and orders her to stop. Mairin remains defiant and declares that she will catch plenty of Pokémon and eventually defeat Alain with her own Mega Evolved Pokémon. Alain sarcastically says that he cannot wait. Their sharp exchange is interrupted by a passing {{fd|Flabébé|Yellow Flower}} {{p|Flabébé}}. Mairin orders Chespie use {{m|Pin Missile}}, though Flabébé counters with a {{m|Magical Leaf}} flurry. Chespie tries a {{m|Vine Whip}}, but Flabébé floats out of the way. With some advice from Alain, switches tactics and {{status|Poison|badly poison}}s Flabébé with a {{m|Toxic}} attack. She catches Flabébé, who she nicknames Bébé, her first Pokémon. After the successful capture, they rush to the nearest [[Pokémon Center]] to have Bébé recover. Mairin realizes Alain has disappeared again, to which [[Nurse Joy]] reveals that she informed Alain that [[Siebold]] of the [[Elite Four]] operates a restaurant nearby. In the kitchen, one of the waiters informs Siebold of a promising challenger. Siebold walks over to Alain's table and instantly notices Alain's [[Mega Ring]], and promptly guides him and Mairin through to the battlefield. Siebold queries Alain about his choice of Charizard, a {{t|Fire}} type with a [[Type#Type effectiveness|big disadvantage]] against his {{type|Water}} {{p|Blastoise}}. Alain stands by his choice, remarking that his [[friendship]] with Charizard goes beyond anything. Alain immediately Mega Evolves his Charizard and starts off the match with Dragon Claw. Blastoise fires off several {{m|Hydro Pump}}s, but after Mega Charizard evades them, it rockets forward with a {{m|Skull Bash}}. Mega Charizard, however, blocks Blastoise's advance with its Dragon Claws. Alain calls for the main course, to which Siebold activates his Key Stone and Blastoise's [[Blastoisinite]] evolves it into Mega Blastoise. Mega Charizard X prepares to land a Steel Wing attack, but is battered down by Blastoise using {{m|Dragon Pulse}}. Siebold remarks that Mega Blastoise has an added advantage with its {{a|Mega Launcher}} [[Ability]]. He orders another Hydro Pump, though Mega Charizard X flies ahead. Mega Blastoise readies a {{m|Power-Up Punch}}, which collides with a Flamethrower attack, pushing both sides back. Mega Charizard X returns to grab a hold of its opponent's shell before delivering a close-range Dragon Claw. Siebold calls for the finishing blow, and a Dragon Pulse defeats Charizard. Nonetheless, Siebold is impressed by Alain's performance. On the road again, Mairin wants to follow Alain so she can get a Mega Stone and Mega Evolve her Pokémon to beat him. He just shrugs and remembers Professor Sycamore declaring mankind is entering "a time of great change". But woe be in his way, with [[Lysandre]], in his laboratory, also interested in the possibilities and immense power offered by Mega Evolution. ==Major events== * [[Alain]], a {{pkmn|Trainer}} wielding [[Mega Evolution]], meets [[Mairin]], a beginning Trainer. * Alain finds a [[Gyaradosite]]. * Mairin {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{p|Flabébé}}, which she [[nickname]]s "Bébé". * Alain has a {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Siebold]] of the [[Kalos]] [[Elite Four]], but loses. * Mairin decides to travel with Alain. {{animeevents|XY}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Alain]] * [[Mairin]] * [[Lysandre]] * [[Astrid]] * [[Remo]] * [[Siebold]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Alain|Charizard}};
